$comment: Single source of truth for the org-level variables copied into newly created/forked repositories. Read at runtime by handle-repository-creation-request.yml (the 'Validate Issue Input' step, via fs.readFileSync against the checked-out working copy - no GitHub API call spent on it). NOTE: dropdown option lists (product line, aspect, project type, tenant name, visibility) are NOT duplicated here - the workflow parses those directly out of .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/repository_creation_request.yml at runtime, so that template file is their only source of truth.
